title: What Does `it` Mean?
instructions: What does `it` refer to inside a lambda with a single parameter?

options.text: The single parameter of the lambda
The return value of the lambda
The variable the lambda is stored in

explanation: When a lambda has exactly one parameter, Kotlin lets you skip naming it and instead refer to it as `it`. So `{ x -> x * 2 }` can be shortened to `{ it * 2 }`. The name `it` is an automatic shorthand for the single parameter.
